newsitem.title: UK: UAE investigates money laundering ring.
newsitem.headline: UAE investigates money laundering ring.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates suspects that a major illicit drugs ring busted last month had also set up money laundering operations in the Gulf Arab state, UAE official sources said on Sunday.

"There is a money laundering investigation," a UAE official on a private visit to Britain told Reuters. "We must clean it up because our reputation is being harmed at a time when we are embarking on major investments (projects) for the future."
The sources said UAE federal authorities suspected possible involvement of high-ranking members of prominent families in the oil-rich state in the money laundering scam.

"They were going to make the UAE a (drugs) production centre and not only a transit point," the UAE official said. "We suspect they also set up projects to clean their profits and channel funds from abroad through them."
The UAE last month said it smashed a drug ring which had set up mandrax pills manufacturing and storage facilities in three of the seven UAE states. Mandrax is a highly addictive sedative.
Drugs confiscated in the bust were valued at $25 million.
UAE sources said two members of the mandrax operation were still at large, including one whom the authorities believed could expose the size of the alleged international money laundering network.
